description: Implementation of QuicIdleNetworkDetector class for detecting idle network conditions in QUIC protocol, including alarm handling, timeout management, and network activity tracking.

classes.name: AlarmDelegate
classes.description: Internal delegate class for handling alarm callbacks within QuicIdleNetworkDetector.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::QuicIdleNetworkDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the detector with provided parameters and creating an alarm.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm events, triggering appropriate timeout or detection callbacks.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::SetTimeouts
methods.description: Sets handshake and idle network timeouts, adjusting bandwidth update timeout if applicable.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::StopDetection
methods.description: Stops detection by canceling alarms and setting timeouts to infinite.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::OnPacketSent
methods.description: Updates state when a packet is sent, possibly adjusting alarm based on PTO delay.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::OnPacketReceived
methods.description: Updates last received packet time and resets alarm.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::SetAlarm
methods.description: Sets or updates the alarm to the nearest timeout deadline.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::MaybeSetAlarmOnSentPacket
methods.description: Adjusts alarm to ensure connection remains alive for the next PTO.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::GetIdleNetworkDeadline
methods.description: Calculates the deadline for idle network detection.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector::GetBandwidthUpdateDeadline
methods.description: Calculates the deadline for bandwidth update.
